title: ApeX Omni (zkLink X custody) — no unprivileged extraction; $30.28M privileged upgrade risk
closed_reasons: withdrawal processing (executeCompressedBlocks / executeBlocks) is onlyValidator and the block state must be SNARK-proven
proxy upgradeTarget / transferMastership are requireMaster (UpgradeGatekeeper, master = governor Gnosis Safe)
all periphery governance functions are onlyGovernor
permissionless withdrawal functions pay the rightful _owner and cannot redirect funds to the caller
acceptETH/acceptERC20 require the caller to pay the receiver first
proxy initialize() is intercepted (revert ini11) — no re-initialization
key_facts: ApeX Omni custody is the zkLink X ZkLink/ZkLinkPeriphery proxy on each of 5 chains (ApeX-deployed per its force-withdrawal docs)
Ethereum 0x35D173cdfE4d484BC5985fDa55FABad5892c7B82 holds $17.33M; BSC $2.86M; Arbitrum $5.68M; Base $3.22M; Mantle $1.20M; total $30,282,912
Arbitrum is the zkLink master chain (chainId 9); totalBlocksProven == totalBlocksExecuted == 211104
UPGRADE_NOTICE_PERIOD == 0 on all chains; governor is a GnosisSafeProxy (threshold 4); master is an UpgradeGatekeeper contract
non-validator execute/commit revert '4'; non-master upgradeTarget revert '1c'; non-governor setters revert '3'; proxy initialize revert 'ini11'
withdrawPendingBalance(victim,...) pays victim (griefing only); acceptERC20 requires real payment
NEAR Intents $3.8M 'Omni' incident (2026-09-28) is a different protocol — not ApeX Omni
caveats: DefiLlama attributes the whole zkLink-X instance balance to ApeX Omni; if third parties share the instance the ApeX-specific share could be lower
P = privileged risk from the 0s-notice upgrade key (governor Safe), not an unprivileged path
SNARK verifier/circuit soundness and Safe signer set were not adversarially testable
USD values use DefiLlama spot prices at capture time (2026-10-23)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from ApeX Omni; the ~$30.28M custody sits in validator-gated, SNARK-proven zkLink X contracts — the only material risk is the privileged 0-notice upgrade path (governor Safe).
